instruction: Query the OQMD database for Ti-O compounds (element_set=Ti,O) using limit=10. Sort the returned results by delta_e ascending in Python, then save the top 5 entries (name/delta_e/stability) to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_8.txt'. Use the OQMD REST API directly with the `requests` library (endpoint: https://oqmd.org/oqmdapi/formationenergy), do NOT use qmpy_rester.
